changes_made.explanation: Minor normalization of model names to consistent capitalization
Normalized BERT-P to BERTScore and ROUGE-L to ROUGE following simplification rules; kept FactKB and UniEval as they are specific model-based metrics
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used; the paper uses pre-trained models (FactKB, UniEval) for automatic evaluation but not LLMs as judges
No human evaluation conducted; the paper explicitly states they use ground-truth summaries to emulate human annotations for active learning experiments

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on active learning for hallucination mitigation in text summarization. It uses automatic metrics (FactKB, UniEval, BERTScore, ROUGE) exclusively for evaluation. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are employed. The paper mentions using gold summaries to emulate human annotations for the active learning framework.
